caseName: New York Ex Rel. Sackett v. Lynch
caseNameFull: The People of the State of New York, on the Relation of Harry P. Sackett v. Thomas M. Lynch, Constituting the State Tax Commission of the State of New York.
attorneys: Mr. Wm. F. Unger for appellant. Mr. Henry Epstein for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellees to dismiss the appeal herein is granted, and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a properly presented federal question. Ki pley v. Illinois, 170 U.S. 182, 186, 187; Layton v. Missouri, 187 U.S. 356, 358; Jacobi v. Alabama, 187 U.S. 133, 135; Saltonstall v. Saltonstall, 276 U.S. 260, 267, 268.
